explain_task.question: Using the revised solver record together with `src/current_heuristic.py` and `src/formulation.tex`, explain why the objective fell from 1030.0 to 925.0 even though the model added the extra-cost mechanism on the A→3 lane. Your answer must name the exact new code variable `area3_excess`, the exact revised constraints `area3_min_share_from_A` and `area3_A_staging_excess`, and the exact CSV parameter fields `min_coal_yard_B_adjusted`, `min_share_area3_from_A`, `area3_A_staging_threshold`, and `area3_A_excess_staging_cost`; then interpret which revised constraints are binding from their reported slack/dual values and give the business meaning of the `3.0` shadow price on `area3_A_staging_excess`. Finally, reconcile the directional business brief with the missing route in `table_1.csv`, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate the current marginal value if the staging threshold were increased far beyond the current level.
